Firebase JS SDK 13.4.0 (Apache-2.0), bundled with esbuild: app, auth, firestore (adds increment, writeBatch).
firebase-play.mjs: same SDK plus Realtime Database (getDatabase, dbRef, dbSet, dbUpdate, dbGet, dbRemove, onValue, onChildAdded, onDisconnect, dbNow, goOffline, goOnline, connectDatabaseEmulator). Loaded only by play.html.
